modules.module_title: Design the software for the Drone system — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: Collaborate with stakeholders to document functional (Flight control, Navigation,Payload integration, communication, Data logging ,mission planning etc.) and non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, security etc.)

Create architectural diagrams that outline the software components and their interactions, define the overall structure of the software, including modules for flight control, data processing, and user interface.
Design navigation algorithms (e.g., waypoints, obstacle avoidance, path planning).
Develop flight control algorithms to manage stabilization, speed, and performance parameters.
Write the source code for each component, focusing on flight control, navigation, and data processing, utilize relevant programming languages (e.g., C++, Python, ROS) based on project requirements.
Ensure that the software is integrated with drone hardware components (e.g., sensors, GPS, motors).

modules.module_title: Conduct thorough testing of drone system software in both — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: Employ simulation tools to test algorithms and flight control without physical hardware
Validate the behavior and performance of the software using a controlled virtual environment
Conduct flight tests to evaluate the software’s performance in real-world conditions
Monitor system behavior, assess navigation accuracy, and verify data processing efficiency during flights
Identify and resolve any issues or bugs found during testing
Optimize algorithms for better performance, reliability, and responsiveness
Document the code, including usage instructions, algorithm explanations, and system architecture
Update and refine the software based on user inputs, testing results, and technology advancements
Prepare the software for deployment on the drone’s onboard systems
